title: Ingest Run
description: Write a parsed run artifact to disk after validating budgets and preventing re-ingestion.
signature: pub fn ingest_run(graph: &Graph, store: &Store, scope: Uuid, artifact: RunArtifact) -> Result<()>
semantics: Validates that the scope exists, every reported budget matches a child node, and no run with this number exists, then writes the artifact.
